  [block-media-split-stack-solutions kind=media-end]
    [marketing-section-module kind=left]
      [marketing-band-stack sticky=true]
        [marketing-media-split kind=media-end orientation=horizontal size=large align=center media=true divided=true fill=canvas aria-label='Content delivery network (CDN)']
          h2 "Content delivery network (CDN)"
          p "Put Azion in front of your origin. Cacheable content is served from Azion's CDN, close to your users, and requests that still need the origin get there faster. Your application stays right where it is."
          button "Docs" → https://www.azion.com/en/documentation/use-cases/improve-performance-and-reliability/accelerate-websites-and-apis-with-a-cdn/
        [marketing-media-split kind=media-end orientation=horizontal size=large align=center media=true divided=true fill=canvas aria-label='Load balancing and failover']
          h2 "Load balancing and failover"
          p "Load Balancer spreads requests across two or more origins, shifts traffic away from any origin that fails, and supports primary and backup origins for active-passive setups."
          button "Docs" → https://www.azion.com/en/documentation/use-cases/improve-performance-and-reliability/keep-an-application-online-when-an-origin-fails/
        [marketing-media-split kind=media-end orientation=horizontal size=large align=center media=true divided=true fill=canvas aria-label='Image processing']
          h2 "Image processing"
          p "Image Processor resizes, crops, and converts images on the fly to the size and format each page needs, and Azion caches every variant. You keep just one original per image."
          button "Docs" → https://www.azion.com/en/documentation/use-cases/improve-performance-and-reliability/optimize-images-for-websites-and-mobile-apps/
        [marketing-media-split kind=media-end orientation=horizontal size=large align=center media=true divided=true fill=canvas aria-label='Performance monitoring']
          h2 "Performance monitoring"
          p "Collect real-user metrics from browsers and a log of every request, with no agents on your servers. Query the data in real time or stream it to the observability tools your team already uses."
          button "Docs" → https://www.azion.com/en/documentation/use-cases/improve-performance-and-reliability/monitor-website-and-api-performance/
